item.title: Luigi Mangione pleads guilty in federal case over insurance CEO killing
item.description: Luigi Mangione admitted in court on Friday to killing a health insurance executive and pleaded guilty to federal charges of ‌stalking the executive with the intent to kill him. The guilty plea will avert a federal trial in the closely watched case over the killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson, a brazen crime that was condemned by public officials but became emblematic of Americans’ frustration with health insurance industry practices. It could also allow him to seek dismissal of state... Publicado también por: South China Morning Post, MarketWatch, Al Jazeera English. Fuente: The Jerusalem Post - International.

item.title: El creciente antisemitismo complica las vacaciones a los judíos: la web para filtrar destinos seguros
item.description: El aumento del antisemitismo global tras el conflicto entre Israel y Palestina parece haber reducido el número de lugares donde los judíos pueden sentirse plenamente seguros . Así lo ha confesado Shay Yaish, que ha creado una página web, que consultan «cientos de personas a diario», para clasificar los diferentes países del mundo en función del riesgo actual que supone para un judío acudir allí de vacaciones.«Con todo el antisemitismo que hay en el mundo, empecé a buscar lugares seguros que los israelíes pudieran visitar», ha declarado Yaish ante el periódico israelí 'The Times of Israel'… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.
item.dc:creator: Pedro González Jalvo

item.title: Incendios forestales arrasan Europa: evacuaciones en Croacia, Alemania, España y Francia
item.description: Los incendios forestales se intensifican en Europa: en Croacia, el fuego arrasó la ciudad turística de Omis, obligando a la evacuación de residentes y visitantes. En el oeste de Alemania, cerca de la frontera con Bélgica, las llamas forzaron evacuaciones masivas. En España, el incendio en Huesca obligó a trasladar los restos históricos de San Juan de la Peña, mientras otro foco avanza en Andalucía. Francia enfrenta su cuarta ola de calor del verano, con nuevos incendios que ponen en alerta a las autoridades. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: In 2017, conservationists began moving young ospreys from Scotland to Dorset
item.description: Conservationists successfully reintroduced ospreys to Dorset, England, after a century-long absence. A study revealed pioneering pairs are crucial for rapid species expansion into new territories. These birds establish separate breeding groups, accelerating population growth significantly. Translocation projects create artificial pioneers, saving decades of natural recolonisation time. New osprey populations are now spreading, connecting southern England with other established areas. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: Grifols, which runs private chain of clinics, to temporarily stop taking donations after new government investigation A chain of private plasma donation clinics in Canada has said it is pausing collections after the deaths of two donors and a new government investigation into potential unsafe practices. Grifols, a Spanish healthcare company which runs 17 clinics in Canada and is the country’s only private clinic for plasma donation, said it informed Health Canada of its decision to temporarily pause collections on Wednesday.
